**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 is the third release candidate:** hook maps for many more cars, the Wi-Fi hotspot for cars that don't have one, and a mapper that maps a car with no map from its own files. 1.1.0 will be this code unless a blocker turns up. **This RC hasn't been checked on a car yet**: please report how it goes. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release.

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.4](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.4)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**. NEMESIS in the app menu is the same as in rc.2.

## What's new since 1.1.0-rc.2

- **Hook maps for many more cars.** A map is now per system build, so one map covers every model on that build. New since rc.2:

  | Region | Cars |
  |---|---|
  | USA | Elantra, Sonata, Santa Fe, Kona, Ioniq, Venue, Veloster N, Palisade 2020-22 (and their hybrids and EVs); Kia K5, Sorento, Stinger, Soul, Seltos 2021, Niro 2020-22, Cadenza, Telluride 2020-21; Sportage Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid, Forte, Carnival 2022, Niro Hybrid and Plug-in Hybrid, Soul and Seltos 2024 (with the Sportage); the 2022 Ioniq 5 on 260903; Ioniq 6 on 260903; Genesis G70 |
  | Canada | the same older Hyundai and Kia models on 260206; Ioniq 6 on 260206; Niro, Sportage, Carnival, Telluride, Forte, Soul, Seltos 2024 on 260206; Ioniq 6 on 260903; Genesis G70 on 260903 |
  | Korea | Kia K5, Sorento, Stinger, Seltos, Soul, Niro, Mohave The Master, K7, Morning, Ray, EV6, K3; Hyundai Sonata, Santa Fe, Palisade, Ioniq 5; Genesis G70 |
  | Singapore | Ioniq 6 |
  | India | Creta |

  Maps made from stock files say "waiting for a check on a car"; maps made from Car Reports need a check on the car too (Settings → **Check the map on this car**) before their hooks run, or "Try unchecked maps". The full list is on [Supported cars](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Supported-cars).
- **A car with no map maps itself.** HMG-API's on-car mapper (Settings → "Map this car from its files") now finds every hook point on every build we've tested, Korea included, instead of leaving a few for a maintainer. It also checks a borrowed name's code, so it no longer picks a wrong method that happens to share a name (it did on Korean software).
- **Points the map lacks, mapped on the car.** When HMG-API's map for your car is older than a hook point, the unit maps that point itself (by name only, checked on the car) and uses it for readings and mods that only observe.
- **The Wi-Fi hotspot for cars that don't have one.** On cars whose software has no hotspot feature (Korean units, the 2023 US Santa Fe, the older Hyundai and Kia builds above), the unit never powered its Wi-Fi chip. A mod can now ask HMG-API for the hotspot, and HMG-API adds the feature (back to stock when no mod asks). Wireless 2.2.0-rc.4 asks. These cars aren't in the wireless mod's car list yet, so it asks you to install anyway.
- **Wireless 2.2.0-rc.4** also brings shared CarPlay identity (thanks to isaacwisdom) and the 2022 Ioniq 5 on 260903 and the Ioniq 6 in Canada: see [its notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.4).
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.3/CHANGELOG.md).

## Car Reports wanted

Some maps came from Car Reports made before this RC checked the code behind 9 of each map's hook points; those 9 were taken from other cars' maps by name. **One Car Report from this RC per row confirms them**, for every model in the row:

| Build | Any one of these |
|---|---|
| Kia, newer US build (260507) | Sportage (any), Telluride, Carnival, Niro (any), Forte, Soul, Seltos 2024 |
| Kia, newer Canadian build (260206) | Niro (any), Sportage (any), Carnival, Telluride, Forte, Soul, Seltos 2024 |
| Hyundai Palisade, US 260903 | Palisade 2023 and on |
| Hyundai Ioniq 5, US 260903 | Ioniq 5 on 260903 |
| Hyundai Ioniq 6 | Canada 260206, or USA/Canada 260903 |
| Hyundai, Korea 260902 | Sonata, Sonata Hybrid, Santa Fe, Palisade |
| Kia, Korea 260902 | EV6, K3 |
| Genesis G70 | USA 260507, Canada 260903 or Korea 260902 |
| Ioniq 6 Singapore, Creta India | either |

A **Check the map on this car** from any car whose map says "waiting for a check on a car" helps too: one check per build makes that build's map run without "Try unchecked maps". More in [#247](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/247).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta, rc.1 or rc.2:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Then restart the head unit once. Your mods and settings stay. To update the wireless mod too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.4.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, pick it in Check USB updates, and **Apply changes**. Wireless 2.2.0-rc.4 needs this RC: update HMG-API first, or both at once.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** as in [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.3-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- The app shows **1.1.0-rc.3** and "Hooks on" on a car that had them. Your mods still run after the update and a restart.
- **Uninstall and install again** (without `PURGE`): the head unit starts normally afterwards, and NEMESIS still starts.
- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto** on a car where they worked with rc.2: music, a call, turn-by-turn on the cluster.
- **A car in the new list:** HMG-API app → Settings → **Check the map on this car**, restart, then a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report).
- **A car with no map:** Settings → "Map this car from its files", then a Car Report.
- **A car without a stock hotspot** (Korea, a 2023 Santa Fe, an older Hyundai or Kia) with the wireless mod: the app shows a Wi-Fi chip after a restart, and how far wireless gets.

## Known issues

- With Android Auto's turns in the car's own format, on-ramps still show the projection icon, so the AR HUD doesn't animate there (wireless #30).
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after installing.

## Going back to 1.0.2

The app won't install an older HMG-API over a newer one, so either:
- **With adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **Without adb:** uninstall HMG-API ([Uninstalling](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Uninstalling), without `PURGE`, so your mods and settings stay), restart, then install [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) as new.

Wireless 2.2.0-rc.4 needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3, so going back to 1.0.2 means going back to wireless 2.1.0 too: remove the mod in the app and apply, then install `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from 1.0.2's release with Check USB updates.

## Reporting

A [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report), or [open an issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with:
- your car;
- the head unit software (e.g. 260507 or 260903);
- the HMG-API version (1.1.0-rc.3) and the wireless mod's version;
- what you did and what happened.

Problems with wireless CarPlay or Android Auto go [in the mod's repo](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose). Please don't post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers; nothing needs them.
